name: Quantum computing task: Write a Qiskit program that transpiles a 5-qubit random
task_prompt: Quantum computing task: Write a Qiskit program that transpiles a 5-qubit random circuit (depth 5) to the basis gates ['rz','sx','x','cx'] with a line coupling map at optimization levels 0-3, printing depth and CX count for each level.
